resources.string: Watchlist, pair sheet and market cards

Logos come from CoinGecko, and from Binance for coins CoinGecko doesn\'t list (e.g. gold, silver, stocks). The app loads all logos at once and keeps them on this device, so neither provider can tell which coins you follow. Coins without a logo show their initials. Favorites get a small star on the logo. Where a switch is off, neither logos nor initials appear; with all switches off, nothing is loaded.
